diagrams.title: **Eight small scripts, one idea at a time
diagrams.caption: **Eight small scripts, one idea at a time.** Each script changes exactly one thing compared with the one before it, so you can open two side by side and see the difference. A helper, `agent_trace_printer.py`, prints every agent run in Part B.

diagrams.title: **What `chain
diagrams.caption: **What `chain.invoke({...})` runs.** The template turns your dict into prompt text, the model answers, and you read the answer from `.text`. The dict keys must match the template's placeholders.
diagrams.svg:
